title: Wildfire in a Narrow Gully: A Geometric Reduction Approach
summary: We consider a bushfire model in a gully. The biological scenario under consideration involves flammable fuel (trees, leaves, etc.) concentrated within the gully, surrounded by rocky hillslopes containing little or no burnable material. The mathematical formulation of the problem is a nonlocal evolution equation of parabolic type. The nonlocality arises from an ignition mechanism that becomes active when the temperature reaches the ignition threshold and is modeled via a kernel interaction with limitrophe areas.
